description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory class, responsible for creating and managing language objects for HTMLPurifier, including caching, fallback logic, and loading language data from files.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for generating HTMLPurifier_Language objects with caching, fallbacks, and language loading features.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the factory, optionally resetting or overwriting with a provided prototype.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the singleton, setting up dependencies and configurations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a language object based on configuration and context, handling class fallback if necessary.

methods.name: getFallbackFor
methods.description: Returns the fallback language code for a given language code.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language data into cache, handling message file inclusion and fallback merging.
